kill.title: Solvency
kill.rule: No reading after 2026-10-08 shows a material shortfall (at least $100 and 1 basis point of a token's credits).

kill.title: Usage
kill.rule: Intents volume over the last 30 days is not below the same 30 days a year earlier.

kill.title: Value capture
kill.rule: Revenue captured by NEAR (90 days, annualised) is at least 10% of the dollar value of one year of new NEAR supply.

kill.title: Security cost
kill.rule: Expected yearly cost of loss events (observed rate, half recovered) is at most 25% of captured revenue.
